arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Paul Clement argued Proposition 106 permanently removes legislative authority.
He claimed the Elections Clause vests power in state legislatures only.
Waxman argued the legislature's claim that people usurped power is misconceived.
He stated the framers would not have expected federal courts to hear this case.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests whether the Elections Clause reserves congressional districting power exclusively to state legislatures or allows the people to act directly.
